ranked_facts.why: The presence of decreased sensation in the right arm cannot be explained by B2 (Inflammatory or Autoimmune Disorder with Neurological Involvement) or B3 (Vascular Disorder with Neurological Involvement) as these conditions would likely present with more diffuse or bilateral symptoms, whereas B1 (Neoplastic Disorder with Neurological Involvement) and B4 (Traumatic or Compressive Disorder with Neurological Involvement) could cause localized sensory deficits.

The significant weight loss of 17 pounds in 1 month is more likely to be associated with B1 (Neoplastic Disorder with Neurological Involvement), such as a tumor, than with B2 (Inflammatory or Autoimmune Disorder with Neurological Involvement), B3 (Vascular Disorder with Neurological Involvement), or B4 (Traumatic or Compressive Disorder with Neurological Involvement), which are less likely to cause such rapid weight loss.
